title: Jewel-Encrusted Smoked Korean Pear Wrap
description: A sweet and savory wrap filled with the flavors of Korea and the crunch of jewel-toned ingredients.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Brush the wrap with vegetable oil and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, until lightly toasted.
In a small bowl, mix together the Korean chili flakes and sesame seeds.
Spread the chili flake mixture evenly over the wrap, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Arrange the smoked pear slices on top of the chili flake mixture.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
Slice the wrap in half and serve immediately.
Optional: garnish with additional sesame seeds or chopped herbs.
Serve with a side of kimchi or pickled vegetables for added flavor and crunch.
